title.zh: EU questions Binance over continued operations despite wind-down order
title.en: EU questions Binance over continued operations despite wind-down order

current_state.zh: EU regulators are questioning Binance over its continued operations in the bloc despite an outstanding wind-down order, raising questions about the exchange's compliance and market access in Europe.
